name: Swine
overview: Scripture clearly identifies the swine as an unclean animal, forbidding the Israelites from eating its flesh or touching its carcass, as emphasized in Leviticus 11:7-8 and Deuteronomy 14:8. This dietary law underscores the holiness and separation expected of God's people. Additionally, the wild boar is depicted as destructive to agriculture, as noted in Psalms 80:13, illustrating its negative impact on the land. These teachings highlight both the physical and spiritual implications of swine in the biblical context.
